payload.title: The lint policy pack decides what is test code twice, with TEST_FILE_RE in the adapter and a hand-copied glob in the ESLint config, and neither covers test helpers, e2e-spec suites or the shared testing library, so no-console, no-explicit-any and the double-assertion rule fire on test infrastructure that the manifest premises exclude.
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/lint-rules-adapter.ts:103 (TEST_FILE_RE matches only names ending in .spec or .test)
tools/aria-adapters/lint-rules-adapter.ts:172-178 (file selection drops test files by TEST_FILE_RE and nothing else)
tools/aria-adapters/lint-rules.eslint.config.mjs:107-115 (policy rules on for every ts file except web and a glob copy of the spec and test suffixes)
tools/aria-adapters/lint-rules-adapter.tool.json:61-72 (premise 2 of no-console says code that runs, not a test fixture)
libs/backend-common/src/database/__tests__/nats-handler-test.helpers.ts:40-52 (three double assertions in a __tests__ helper that is scanned)
apps/farm-service/test/batch.e2e-spec.ts:86 (console.log in an e2e suite whose suffix is e2e-spec, not .spec)
tools/aria-adapters/lint-rules-adapter.test.ts:465 (the only test-file pin names a .spec.ts path)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per fact (CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach, tier 2: the correct behaviour is the default) and the manifest premise of the three policy rules that a finding is code that runs and not a test fixture.
payload.notes: A helper such as database/__tests__/nats-handler-test.helpers.ts, an apps/farm-service/test/*.e2e-spec.ts suite or a libs/testing factory is scanned because its name does not end in .spec.ts or .test.ts, and the config ignore repeats exactly that suffix list. On the measured scope 4 of the 25 policy findings (16 percent) sit in one helper, and at this revision at least 8 non-spec test files in apps, libs and platform/libs carry the constructs. Each such finding is refuted by the contract's own premise, so the label queue measures the rule on noise and can retire a true rule; adding a suffix to TEST_FILE_RE leaves the config behind because only a .spec.ts path is pinned. Close condition: Build the config's ignores from the same predicate the adapter uses (export one test-path matcher from lint-rules-adapter.ts), extend it to __tests__ directories, test directories, *.e2e-spec.ts, *.integration.ts and libs/testing, and add an adapter test where a __tests__ helper and an e2e-spec file carrying each construct draw no policy finding. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 3). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
